name: Inugami no Tsuma
source:
Sakuya is sent to ask forgiveness from a guardian god due to never ending snowstorm. She is ready to get eaten, but the dog god has different plans on this girl's body.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
由于暴风雪永无休止，咲夜被派去向守护神请求宽恕。她已经做好了被吃掉的准备，但狗神对这个女孩的身体却另有打算。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
